description: Hurl a wave of cinder that rolls along the ground and bursts against foes.
name: Cinder Wave

description: Surge forward through the air, trailing pale light. Crosses gaps no jump can reach.
name: Gale Dash

description: Knit wounds with pale light drawn from the moon. Restores a portion of max HP.
name: Mending Pulse

description: Moonrise Leap: Lucien learns to catch the moonlight and spring a second time mid-air, a pale crescent flashing beneath his boots.
name: Moonrise Leap
